q1_issues.issue: "al-Qaida operatives" is a proper noun premodifying a common-noun head, which must attach by the opaque Possession; PartOf is the very link the instruction set says never to invent there.

"those areas" is a demonstrative anaphor on the Pakistani cities of the first clause, but a fresh unlinked (GroupOf sk_areas_1 area) is minted, so the parse asserts arrests in an area set connected to nothing.

q2_gaps: "other" as a complement-set modifier on a plural NP ("other members of the organization") — no licensed carrier (RestOf covers only "the rest of" / "the remaining"), so the restriction was dropped

coreference from a top-level clause back to a referent introduced only inside a sealed attitude complement ("believed to be in Pakistani cities … those areas") — the seal rules give no route for linking across the boundary
notes: The impersonal reported attitude is handled correctly — attitude event with no Experiencer, content sealed under Theme, subject typing and compound decomposition projected — and the "many of the arrests" partitive plus the light-verb "have taken place" (tense straight on the event-noun witness) follow the instruction set. The distributive rule for the descriptive modifier "key" is the right route.
